repo="BestNameYet/Terminals"
for item in files:
 path=item["path"]; expected=item["content"].encode()
 probe=subprocess.run(["gh","api",f"repos/{repo}/contents/{path}"],capture_output=True,text=True)
 if probe.returncode==0:
  got=json.loads(probe.stdout)
  existing=base64.b64decode(got["content"])
  if existing!=expected: raise RuntimeError("Target exists with different content: "+path)
  print("ALREADY_IDENTICAL",path,got["sha"])
  continue
 if "404" not in probe.stderr: raise RuntimeError("Cannot verify absence: "+path+" "+probe.stderr[:300])
 content=base64.b64encode(expected).decode()
 result=subprocess.run(["gh","api",f"repos/{repo}/contents/{path}","--method","PUT","-f","message=Complete task 1794193447 wrapper design","-f","content="+content],capture_output=True,text=True)
 if result.returncode: raise RuntimeError("Publish failed "+path+": "+result.stderr[:500])
 created=json.loads(result.stdout)
 read=subprocess.run(["gh","api",f"repos/{repo}/contents/{path}"],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True)
 actual=base64.b64decode(json.loads(read.stdout)["content"])
 if actual!=expected: raise RuntimeError("Remote verification mismatch: "+path)
 print("VERIFIED",path,"bytes",len(expected),"sha256",hashlib.sha256(actual).hexdigest(),"commit",created["commit"]["sha"])
task="Tasks/User Prompt Task Queue/user-prompt-task-1794193447.json"
original=subprocess.run(["gh","api",f"repos/{repo}/contents/{task}"],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True)
source=json.loads(base64.b64decode(json.loads(original.stdout)["content"]))
assert source["task_type"]=="account_custom_instruction_wrapper_design" and source["status"]=="pending"
print("ORIGINAL_TASK_PRESERVED",task)
